# Kefas Manda

> Kefas Manda is a software developer in Cape Town, South Africa, focused on applied AI, agent infrastructure, backend systems, and data pipelines.

This is Kefas's personal portfolio. It documents professional experience, selected projects, technical capabilities, education, and public contact information. The linked pages are the source of truth for current roles, project scope, and results.

- [FineApp case study in Markdown](https://www.kefas.co.za/fineapp.md): The original marketplace engineering and its change to paid freelancer listings with direct email and WhatsApp enquiries. Platform messaging and payments are historical features that have been removed.

- [Schoolscape case study](https://www.kefas.co.za/schoolscape): CRM data reconciliation and migration preparation, including aggregate outcomes, validation, and handover methodology.
- [FineApp case study](https://www.kefas.co.za/fineapp): Product ownership, historical booking, messaging and payment work, and the decision to simplify the conversion journey.
